title: Quickfire afternoon capacity & network checks
content:
Afternoon quickfire runlog - short, actionable. Use as my shift checklist and handoff notes.

Top-level goals:
- keep dedicated pools healthy for canary + prod routes
- reclaim idle GPUs from transient jobs
- watch network egress for tail spikes

Checklist (run now):
[ ] check gpu-util on pools: dedicated-a, dedicated-b, burst-x
    -> kubectl top nodes | grep gpu (watch for <10% long tails)
[ ] list idle pods >30m: ./tools/find-idle-pods --min-idle=30m
[ ] drain candidate node if idle + no critical pods: kubectl drain n-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
[ ] validate KV cache hit rate for chat-route: /metrics/cache/kv_hit_rate (target >0.6)
[ ] run quick ping/iperf to egress-gateway-2 (look for jitter >10ms)

Capacity snapshot (quick numbers to paste to handoff):
- pool dedicated-a: 24 GPUs (18 in use, 75% avg utl today)
- pool dedicated-b: 32 GPUs (26 in use, 81% peak)
- burst-x (preemptible): 40 GPUs (12 in use, mostly quant jobs)

Notes / anomalies:
- saw 2x burst-x preemptions between 13:10-13:25 - probably batch job INFR-842; asked Meera to follow up with owners.
- small tail of 6 nodes with <8% GPU utl for last 2 hours, likely stale jobs. Marking candidate for reclaim.
- network: egress-gateway-2 95th p95 latency jumped from 12ms -> 48ms around 14:05; correlates with a large embedding batch from customer-eu.

Quick commands to run before handoff:
- ./tools/pool-util --pool=dedicated-a --since=3h > /tmp/ded-a-util.txt && tail -n 20 /tmp/ded-a-util.txt
- kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running | grep gpu | awk '{print $1, $8, $9}' | head -n 40
- ssh ops@node-12 "sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,nounits"

Action items (assign/notes):
- [Meera] inspect INFRA-842 batch job (high preemptions) and propose throttling window or slot reservation.
- [Noah] run a one-off egress isolation test for gateway-2; confirm BGP flaps not implicated.
- [Riley] schedule reclaim of 4 nodes from burst-x after 16:00 if no cold-start alerts.

Handoff blurb (copy/paste):
"Afternoon shift: reclaimed 0 nodes so far. Pools stable but dedicated-b hit 81% peak; watch canaries for latency regressions. Network spike at 14:05 likely due to large embedding job (INFRA-842) — Meera aware. If you see >3% 5xx on chat-route, rollback to model v2.1-fallback.

Open questions / TODOs to follow-up:
- should we introduce a 1hr soft-eviction for transient gpu jobs with <5% utl? (pros/cons)
- collect longer tail data for KV cache hit-rate for week window (put a Grafana panel)
- verify autoscaler scaleDownDelay for dedicated-a (current: 10m) — maybe bump to 20m to avoid churn

Random notes to self:
- remember to update incident-runbook with new egress-gateway troubleshooting steps.
- ping @infra-rotations on Slack to confirm next oncall for weekend.

End of quickfire. Keep it short in handoff.
